name: Abode of Ignominy
summary: Abode of Ignominy is a delve in the northern part of Northern Elsweyr, located southwest of Riverhold, containing undead. It is found east of Starlight Adeptorium and west of Riverhold. There is a cooking fire at the camp in front of the delve. A copy of Praise to Mafala! is found in the northwestern chamber. The Riverhold Fragment is found in the same room.
